content.text:
Clattertrap rules v1

World
- Units are centimetres and degrees. The origin is bottom-left, x runs right, y runs up. A part's position is its centre unless the table says otherwise.
- Angles are counterclockwise positive. angle_deg 0 is horizontal; a beam at -15 slopes down to the right.
- Gravity is 981 cm/s^2 downward. Everything starts at rest and physics starts at once, so anything in the air falls.
- The floor is solid. There are no walls and no ceiling: a part whose centre goes more than 50 cm outside the level rectangle is removed.
- Time advances in steps of 1/120 s. A run ends when the goal is met, when the level's time limit passes, or when everything has stopped moving.

Materials
| material | mass of a ball | bounce | friction |
| steel | 1.00 kg | 0.2 | 0.2 |
| wood | 0.15 kg | 0.3 | 0.5 |
| rubber | 0.20 kg | 0.8 | 0.9 |
Bounce between two bodies is the larger of the pair; friction is the average. Beams, dominoes, crates, seesaws, and buckets are wood.

Parts you may place
The level's inventory says how many of each kind. Kinds it does not list are not available.
| kind | fields | size | behaviour |
| beam | x_cm, y_cm, length_cm (20..150), angle_deg | 4 cm thick | fixed wood plank |
| funnel | x_cm, y_cm (throat centre), mouth_cm (30..150), throat_cm (14..mouth), height_cm (20..80) | 2 cm walls | fixed; two walls slope in from the mouth down to the throat |
| ball | x_cm, y_cm, material (steel, wood, rubber) | radius 6 cm | rolls and bounces as its material does |
| domino | x_cm, y_cm, angle_deg (default 0) | 4 by 20 cm | wood tile standing on end; tips when pushed |
| crate | x_cm, y_cm, side_cm (10..40) | square | wood box |
| seesaw | x_cm, y_cm, length_cm (40..150), angle_deg (default 0) | 4 cm thick | wood plank that pivots freely about its centre, which is fixed in space |
| pendulum | x_cm, y_cm (the pin), length_cm (20..120), angle_deg (default 0, measured from straight down) | steel weight of radius 5 cm | swings on a rigid rope from the pin and is released at once |
| spring_pad | x_cm, y_cm, angle_deg (default 0) | 30 by 4 cm | fixed plate; a body that lands on it gets a kick of 0.6 N s along the plate's normal: a wood ball leaves at 4.1 m/s and rises about 85 cm, a steel ball at 0.6 m/s rises 2 cm |
| bucket | x_cm, y_cm (centre of the floor's underside), width_cm (15..60), height_cm (15..60) | 2 cm walls | wood open box; it can move |
| balloon | x_cm, y_cm | radius 10 cm | rises at up to 1.5 m/s and slides along the underside of anything above it; a pin pops it |
| pin | x_cm, y_cm (the base), angle_deg (default -90, pointing down) | 1 by 16 cm | fixed needle |
| rope | a, b, max_length_cm (10..200) | no body | ties the centres of parts a and b; slack until taut, then keeps them within that length |

Goal objects, which only a level places
| bell | brass disc of radius 10 cm hung below its anchor | rings when hit hard enough: a wood ball at 1.4 m/s or a steel ball at 0.2 m/s |
| button | 12 by 3 cm cap on a spring | pressed when pushed down its full travel and held there |
| basket | open box with 2 cm walls | counts objects that come to rest inside it |

Goals
ring, press, fill (count objects at rest inside the basket), or pop. A goal may list via: part ids that must be touched in that order before the goal counts. The waypoints and the goal must be the work of one chain of parts that have touched each other since the start; a part that moves on its own and never meets that chain does not count, and neither do objects it leaves in the basket.

Placement rules
- Every placed part's centre must lie inside a build zone. Fixed objects are exempt.
- Nothing may overlap at the start: not another part, a fixed object, or the floor. Leave a gap of a few millimetres.
- Every part has a unique id; the fixed objects' ids are taken.
- Lengths outside the ranges above are rejected. check lists every problem with its JSON path and a fix.

Scene JSON
{"level": "<level id>", "parts": [{"id": "example", "kind": "beam", "x_cm": 120, "y_cm": 210, "length_cm": 120, "angle_deg": -15}]}
Field names carry their units. The full schema: clattertrap rules --schema

bell-drop: Ring the bell (tier 1)
Goal: ring bell.
Time limit: 20 s. World: 400 by 300 cm.

A steel ball hangs in the air at (70, 280), top left, and falls from the start. The bell hangs at (360, 100) on the right from a bracket 50 cm above it. The build zone covers x from 30 to 340 at every height. Nothing else is in the way.

Fixed objects:
  ball0: steel ball at (70, 280)
  bell: bell at (360, 100), hung 50 cm below its anchor
Build zones: x 30..340, y 0..300
Inventory: beam 4, domino 6, seesaw 1
